title: LFQ Mass Spectrometry Analysis
author: Le Zhang
materials: Process the LC–MS/MS LFQ data with Progenesis QI software (Nonlinear Dynamics, version.4.2) with protein identification carried out using the Mascot search algorithm (Matrix Science, v. 2.7). Perform feature/peptide extraction, chromatographic/spectral alignment (one run was chosen as a reference for alignment), data filtering, and quantitation of peptides and proteins. Calculate a normalization factor for each run to account for differences in sample load between injections as well as differences in ionization. Determine the normalization factor by comparing the abundance of the spike in Pierce Retention Time Calibration mixture among all the samples. Set up the experimental design to group multiple injections from each run. Tabulate raw and normalized abundances, and maximum fold change for each feature in the data set. Export combined MS/MS spectra as .mgf (Mascot generic files) for database searching. Export Mascot search results as .xml files using a significance cutoff of p c 0.05 and FDR of 1 % and then import into the Progenesis QI software, where search hits were assigned to corresponding aligned spectral features. Calculate relative protein fold changes from the sum of all unique and non-conflicting, normalized peptide ion abundances for each protein on each run. Conduct additional downstream biostatistical analyses utilizing a custom R script. Use an uncorrected nominal P-value to determine significance in the proteomic analysis, as the differentially expressed protein analysis was conducted on individual-level data with only 12 subjects. Identify differentially expressed proteins using only raw p-values without any correction to address potential low-power issues, representing a disease trend.

steps.title: Tissue Dissolution and Lysis
steps.instruction: Dissolve control and PD brain tissue samples in RIPA buffer containing protease and phosphatase inhibitor cocktail.

substeps.instruction: Add 400μL RIPA buffer containing protease and phosphatase inhibitor cocktail to the tissue.
Sonicate at 10% amplitude for 15 seconds using one-second bursts.
Centrifuge samples at 14.6K RPM for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Protein Extraction and Quantitation
steps.instruction: Extract proteins from the supernatant and prepare the protein pellet for digestion.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100μL of supernatant to a new tube.
Perform protein extraction using the Chloroform:Methanol:Water method.
Air dry the resulting protein pellet.
Dissolve the pellet in 80-μl 8 M urea containing 0.4 M ammonium bicarbonate.
Determine protein amount via NanoDrop.
Aliquot 50μg total protein, bringing the final volume to 80μL with 8 M urea containing 0.4 M ammonium bicarbonate.

steps.title: Protein Reduction and Alkylation
steps.instruction: Prepare proteins for digestion through reduction and alkylation.

substeps.instruction: Reduce samples with DTT for 10 minutes at 37 °C.
Alkylate Cysteine with iodoacetamide for 30 minutes at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Enzymatic Digestion
steps.instruction: Perform sequential digestion using LysC and trypsin.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 μL of 0.1 μg/μL LysC and incubate overnight at 37 °C.
Add 2 μL of 0.5 μg/μL trypsin and incubate at 37 °C for 6 hours.

steps.title: Quenching and Desalting
steps.instruction: Stop the digestion process and remove salts from the peptides.

substeps.instruction: Quench digestion with 0.1% trifluoroacetic acid (TFA).
Desalt samples using a C18 UltraMicro Spin column (The Nest Group).
Dry the effluents from the desalting step.
Re-dissolve in 5 μL 70% FA and 35 μL 0.1% TFA.

steps.title: Sample Preparation for LC-MS/MS
steps.instruction: Finalize peptide samples for injection into the mass spectrometer.

substeps.instruction: Take an aliquot to determine the total digested protein amount.
Add a 1:10 dilution of Pierce Retention Time Calibration Mixture (Cat# 88321) to each sample for LFQ normalization.
Dilute digests to 0.05 μg/μL with 0.1% TFA.

steps.title: UPLC-Orbitrap Fusion Analysis
steps.instruction: Inject samples and acquire MS/MS data using the Orbitrap Fusion system.

substeps.instruction: Inject 5 μL of each triplicate analysis in block randomized order.
Set MS resolution to 120,000 and MS/MS resolution to 30,000.
Acquire MS and MS/MS (HCD) spectra with a three-second cycle time and Dynamic Exclusion enabled.
Detect all MS (Profile) and MS/MS (centroid) peaks in the Orbitrap.
Perform trapping for 3 min at 5 μl/min using 99% Buffer A (0.1% FA in water) and 1% Buffer B (0.075% FA in acetonitrile (ACN)).
Elute with a linear gradient: 25% B at 150 min, 50% B at 170 min, 85% B at 175 min, and back down to 3% at 182 min.
Follow each injection with two blanks: first 100% ACN, then Buffer A.
